reviewed_by: Claude review of Workbench view URL ownership
reason: The mobile Workbench navigation test flaked because BrowserRouter commits locations in a transition: setView updated view state urgently, so the Browser pane rendered while useSearchParams() still said view=code, and the engine selector rebuilt the query from that snapshot (view=code&browserEngine=native); the requestedView effect then restored Code. SessionsPage now derives the view from the URL (view-less links keep the last URL-named view) and routes every search-param write through one updater that composes from the address bar. workbench-view-authority covers each changed writer: mobile nav plus engine selection (the deterministic regression check), the phone shell's Chat/Terminal/Activity/More tabs from #355, New chat (openUnattachedChatView), conversation URL identity (openSessionChatView), handoff recovery (clearSubmittedContext), drawer push/reload navigation, transcript search hits, chat inside the Browser view, and switching every primary view. workbench-navigation-core and real-core-browser-handoff exercise session identity and the Browser engine against real Core with the production bundle. tests/test_playwright_impact.py guards the new catalog area.
exclusions: No frontend unit tests: the defect is an ordering race between React's urgent render and the router's transition, only observable with the real router in a browser, and SessionsPage has no component harness; Playwright is the layer where it escaped. No native tests: no Tauri/Rust change. Other mobile widths (small/wide/ledger/landscape) are excluded because the change is width-independent URL state already covered at 390px on Chromium and WebKit plus desktop. No full suites.
